_comment: Seed fixture for the vm-sparklines-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000000715 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — sixth port after
activity-log-htmx (MR !2334 / ka-0000004584), related-tickets-htmx
(MR !2346 / ka-0000005540), header-incident-summary-htmx (MR !2347 /
ka-0000005304), reproduction-steps-htmx (ka-0000007835),
reporter-info-htmx (ka-0000004065), and event-timeline-htmx
(ka-0000000243)). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives alongside the
Go-coded `vm-sparklines` slug (widgets_phase7.go) rather than
replacing it. Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: vm-sparklines-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/vm-sparklines-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `vm-sparklines` renderer at
widgets_phase7.go::renderVMSparklines — flat series[] with
service/metric/unit/state plus pre-computed latest/min/max. Three
intentional parity gaps documented in TestVMSparklinesParity and
the port doc:
1. uPlot canvas (data-uplot-config) — produced server-side via
MarshalSparkConfig and has no template-scope analogue. The
htmx body emits the static <ul> fallback only.
2. latest/min/max derivation — Go path computes these from
points[]/x[]/y[]; htmx template requires producers to supply
them pre-computed (numbers are formatted via {{printf "%.2f" ...}}
for parity with the Go renderer's chrome).
3. State sanitization — Go path lowercases the state via
strings.ToLower; htmx template emits state verbatim. Producers
should pre-lower to one of healthy/warn/critical.
